channel.title: The Morecambe and Wise Show
channel.desc: A complete episode of The Morecambe and Wise Show, that had been considered lost for over 50 years. Eric's son Gary Morecambe discovered the programme in an unmarked film can, and now it has been lovely restored and can be enjoyed in full for the first time since being broadcast on October 8th 1970.
